drafted_from: tool:search-everything-with-one-question row in tools/search-everything-with-one-question/tool-rows.json, do-work/search-everything.mjs, test/search-everything.test.mjs and the sample run of the container row that calls the same searchEverything function
start_here: Say to your AI: "Search everything I keep for merlinfalcon: every list, record and my file names, best match first, and tell me where each hit is." It writes a one-line input file, runs the search through your own Trillion MCP client and answers from each hit's said and address.
no_lists_because: It names no list: it asks every kind of record and the file names the same question through your records door and answers one merged ranking.
instructions: 1. Have your Trillion MCP client set up on this computer and write client.json with argv (the command that starts it on standard input and output), resource "@own-records" and files_resource "@namespace"; it holds no credential, the client signs in itself.
2. Say what you want to find; your AI writes input.json {question (at most 500 characters), type? to keep only one kind of record and leave the files out, limit? 1 to 200, 60 when left out}.

3. It runs `node trillion-workshop/tools/records-door/do-work/run-with-stdio-mcp.mjs client.json trillion-workshop/tools/search-everything-with-one-question/do-work/search-everything.mjs searchEverything input.json` and you read the last JSON line: result {question, terms, results, unavailable, pending}.

4. Answer from each result's said and cite it by its address (records:read for a record, find_file for a file); open a hit by calling its address. unavailable names a place that could not answer and why, pending one still working: ask again in a few seconds.

worked_examples.title: One word found in three kinds of record and one file name
worked_examples.ask: Search everything I keep for merlinfalcon.
worked_examples.given: From tools/search-everything-with-one-question/test/search-everything.test.mjs (the sample the container version of this search runs; both call searchEverything): input.json is {"question": "merlinfalcon"}; the account holds a sample-contacts row c1 ("met the merlinfalcon keeper"), a sample-invoices row i1 ("merlinfalcon feed, 3 bags"), a sample-places row p1 ("merlinfalcon aviary"), another place p2 that does not hold the word, and the files /Notes/merlinfalcon care.txt and /Notes/other.txt. The command is `node trillion-workshop/tools/records-door/do-work/run-with-stdio-mcp.mjs client.json trillion-workshop/tools/search-everything-with-one-question/do-work/search-everything.mjs searchEverything input.json`.
worked_examples.hands_back: The last line is {result: {question: "merlinfalcon", terms: ["merlinfalcon"], results: [...], unavailable: [], pending: []}, started_at, finished_at}. results are, in order, record:c1, record:i1, record:p1 (each found_in ["written"], the first first in its own lane with score 0.01639, each with address {resource: "@own-records", operation: "records:read", input: {id, type}}) and then file:/Notes/merlinfalcon care.txt (found_in ["name"], address {resource: "@namespace", operation: "find_file"}). The other place and other.txt are not listed. If the files may not be searched they appear under unavailable and the records still answer.
